# apipbx_outbound_route (Resource)

Sends outbound calls matching a pattern through trunks. Import with "<tenant id>/<route id>".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `patterns` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--patterns))
- `position` (Number) Lower matches first.
- `tenant_id` (String)
- `trunks` (List of String) Trunk ids in failover order.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `pin_set_id` (String) A PIN set (apipbx_pin_set): the caller must key in one of its PINs before the call is placed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--patterns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `patterns`

Required:

- `match` (String) Asterisk pattern: X 0-9, Z 1-9, N 2-9, [1-3], . one or more, ! zero or more.

Optional:

- `prefix` (String) Digits stripped before dialling.
- `prepend` (String) Digits added before dialling.
